Weapon Name Generator

Forge fantasy weapon names with legendary epithets — 'Dawnbreaker, Blade of the Fallen King'.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a weapon type.
  2. Press Forge Weapons.
  3. Click any weapon to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which weapon types are included?

Swords, axes, bows, daggers, hammers, staves, and spears — each with fitting name parts.

What are epithets?

Every weapon gets an epithet like 'of the Fallen King' or 'the Oathkeeper'.

How many per click?

8 weapons per click, all unique in the batch.

How do I copy one?

Click any weapon to copy its full name.
